newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling on buyer apathy.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling on buyer apathy.

text.p: Share prices on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may fall marginally as retail investors are unlikely to make fresh commitments, brokers said.
"Small investors may show reluctance in buying which may push prices down for a second straight session. They are not quite interested to invest at the moment," said broker A.H. Howlader.
Brokers said leather and engineering scrips which gained in the previous week might fall.
The DSE all-share price index closed 83.29 points or 4.2 percent down at 1896.38 on a turnover of 64 million taka on Saturday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
